services.name: Private Rental
services.desc: Host your own private sauna + cold plunge experience for up to 12 guests. Perfect for birthdays, team gatherings, or wellness nights with friends. You’ll have the entire space to yourselves-just $275/hour. We offer two flexible options for private sauna bookings, perfect for both planned gatherings and spontaneous escapes. Any available community sauna session can be reserved as a private rental if you're the first to book.
